comment: A conceptual sheet by Colin Raffel (2004): one of five identical LDR/op-amp filter stages is drawn, driven by a BA6214 LED VU-meter chip; no designators, quantities are per the five stages. Most of the sheet is a 'How it works' text.
uncertain: *k resistors: value not given, to be matched to the LDR
0.003uF and 0.002uF (stages 3 and 4): not written, inferred from the stepping .005/.004/.../.001
Op amps: type and count not given; 10 single op amps assumed (one LDR inverting stage plus one high-pass stage per stage)
rows: input resistor of each LDR stage; 'tweak to match value of the LDR', no value given
one per stage, between the LDR stage and the high-pass filter
feedback resistor of each filter op amp
LED string resistor at the BA6214
BA6214 pin 7 to ground, in parallel with the 10uf
stage 1 (series and feedback caps both marked *uf)
stage 3; inferred from '.005uf at stage 1, .004uf at stage 2, up to .001uf at stage 5'
two op amps per stage, no part number given; drawn as single sections
LDRs 1-5, each lit by one of the LEDs (LED/LDR pairs); no type given
